scope: Research preflight only. course.yaml currently has demo: null. This contract proposes PeakEstimationLab but does not edit the course, lesson, component, registry, or UI kit.
source_grounding: .claude/skills/lesson-factory/SKILL.md (model gate explicitly waived by the user; all other constraints retained)
research reads/summaries for jos-sasp ch. 5, MIT 6.341 lectures 15/17 and PS9, Lyons 3.11, Schaedler 24-26, Oppenheim-Schafer 10.2, and Stoica-Moses 2.3

study.output: One JSON report; any contract violation exits nonzero via an assertion.

frozen_inputs_and_units.tone_type: analytic complex exponential; this removes negative-frequency image leakage
frozen_inputs_and_units.transform_length: L=Q*N; only L-N zeros are appended
frozen_inputs_and_units.normalization: All magnitudes divide by sum_n w[n], so a bin-centered unit complex tone reads 1 (0 dB).
frozen_inputs_and_units.db_floor: Only the three-bin interpolation input floors magnitude at 1e-14 (-280 dB) to make exact-null floating residuals symmetric; raw linear magnitudes control all other checks.

formulas.zero_padded_dft: X_L[k]=X_N(q=k*N0/L); zero-valued terms n=N,...,L-1 add nothing
formulas.grid_spacing: Delta q=N0/L original bins and Delta f=fs/L Hz
formulas.hann_main_lobe: First null offsets are +/-2*N0/N original bins; null-to-null width is 4*N0/N original bins =4*fs/N Hz
formulas.db_parabola: For dB samples alpha,beta,gamma around largest grid sample, p=0.5*(alpha-gamma)/(alpha-2*beta+gamma), q_hat=(k+p)/Q, and A_hat_dB=beta-0.25*(alpha-gamma)*p
formulas.bump_rule: On q=9+r/4096, r=0,...,10240, a bump is a strict local maximum in [9.5,11] with magnitude at least 50% of the maximum over [9,11.5].

invariants_and_acceptance.pass: For Q in {1,4,16}, max complex difference between the zero-padded DFT and direct DTFT at every displayed coordinate is <1e-12.
At N=64, grid spacing decreases 16 -> 4 -> 1 Hz while Hann null-to-null width remains 64 Hz =4 original bins.
At common L=1024 and 1 Hz display spacing, N=256 narrows the Hann lobe to 16 Hz =1 original bin, exactly one quarter of N=64 width; both first-null residuals are <1e-12.
The three Q=1 frequency biases match the frozen values within 1e-9 original bin and are not equal; every Q=4 absolute bias is <0.002 original bin.
N=64 has one qualifying bump at 0 degrees but two at 90 degrees, and both quadrature bump-to-tone assignment errors exceed 0.4 original bin.
At N=256 both 0- and 90-degree cases have two qualifying peaks, each within 0.05 original bin of its true tone.

boundary_cases: Exactly bin-centered and half-bin isolated tones return zero frequency error for all three declared windows under the dB floor convention.
If alpha-2*beta+gamma is zero (for example three equal dB samples), p is undefined and the demo must show no estimate rather than divide by zero.
Zero amplitude has no peak and no dB estimate; disable the estimator and label the precondition amplitude>0.
Coincident tones reduce to one phasor-summed line, or cancel at equal amplitude/opposite phase; bump count cannot identify two components.
The three-point estimator is valid only for one isolated local peak. The two-tone phase experiment intentionally violates that model.
All PASS/FAIL decisions use raw double-precision values; rounded numbers are display-only.

demo_contract.d1_sentence: The learner changes spectral sampling, informative duration, window, and relative phase and watches grid density, physical lobe width, interpolation bias, and the number and trustworthiness of apparent peaks change independently.
demo_contract.why_not_static: The guided task requires holding L fixed while exchanging padding for real samples, hitting an error target, and perturbing phase to make a visually persuasive two-bump answer fail against known truth.
demo_contract.initial_state: Phase trap: pair mode, rectangular N=64, Q=16, phi=90 degrees; two deep, symmetric bumps are visible at q=9.582764 and 10.917236 while truth markers remain at q=10 and 10.5 and the location audit reads FAIL.

presets.label: Coarse peak
presets.observable: absolute error 0.167044 original bin; FAIL <0.1 target

presets.label: Padded peak
presets.observable: absolute error 0.001008 original bin while width stays 4 original bins; PASS

presets.label: Phase trap
presets.observable: two bumps, each displaced 0.417236 original bin; FAIL truth audit

presets.label: Long record
presets.observable: same L=1024 and 1 Hz grid, narrowed lobe, two peaks within 0.001 original bin

controls: Panel outer container and PresetGroup for the four named presets; activeIndex is null after manual departure.
Kit Button group for mode and window; native aria-pressed semantics.
Indexed Slider for N and Q, with display and aria-valuetext reporting samples, L, and Hz.
Phase Slider in pair mode, 0..90 degrees, step 1; exact 0 and 90 degree Button anchors remain keyboard reachable.
No random API, timer, network, worker, animation, or new dependency.
guided_tasks: From Coarse peak, change only Q until absolute frequency error is <0.1 original bin; Q=4 is the first allowed pass and width must remain 4 original bins.
At N=64,Q=1,q=10.31, switch windows and compare the signed frequency and amplitude biases without calling any window unbiased.
From Phase trap, toggle 90 to 0 degrees: two false bumps collapse to one although tones and record length do not change.
Compare Phase trap with Long record: L and the 1 Hz grid remain fixed, duration changes 62.5 to 250 ms, and the truth-location audit passes.
readouts: N, duration ms, Q, L, display spacing in Hz and original bins
window null-to-null width in Hz and original bins
single mode: true q/f, center bin, p, q_hat/f_hat, signed frequency error, fitted amplitude error
pair mode: phase, qualifying bump count and locations, truth-assignment errors, PASS/FAIL
persistent causal label: padding adds DTFT coordinates; acquired duration changes the lobe
demo_contract.visual: Responsive SVG over q=[8.5,12] with a normalized dB path, sampled coordinates as dots, first-null guides, truth markers, fitted parabola in single mode, and bump/valley labels in pair mode. Use currentColor/theme classes and shape/dash cues, not hue alone.
demo_contract.feedback_budget: At most about 513 plotted q values times 256 samples per input plus three estimator samples; compute synchronously. Use the study's finer 1/4096 grid only for frozen acceptance values, not live rendering.
demo_contract.accessibility: Existing Panel/PresetGroup/Button/Slider/Readout/TargetList primitives; native keyboard controls, >=44 px targets, live text equivalent to the SVG, no horizontal scroll at 360 px.
demo_contract.honesty_limits: Noiseless analytic complex tones isolate the window phenomena. This is not a real-cosine, SNR, probability-of-detection, or universal Rayleigh-resolution claim; two visible bumps are explicitly not evidence of two unbiased estimates.

demo_acceptance.D1: PASS when all four guided tasks expose independently changing quantities and truth-based failure, not merely moving curves.
demo_acceptance.D2: PASS when every control updates in one frame under 200 ms with no asynchronous work.
demo_acceptance.D3: PASS when initial Phase trap and exactly four named presets match the frozen readouts.
demo_acceptance.D4: PASS when target states use raw values and the first passing padding factor and fixed-L duration comparison are recognizable.
demo_acceptance.D5: PASS when one default-exported client component uses only existing UI primitives, no dependency/network/global state, and remains approximately <=200 LOC.
demo_acceptance.numeric: PASS only if all six study assertions in invariants_and_acceptance pass in the standalone script and equivalent component tests.
demo_acceptance.manual: Keyboard-run all controls; inspect light/dark at desktop and 360 px; verify preset clearing, aria-live readouts, endpoint finiteness, and non-color truth/failure cues.
